task_description: Classify each patient comment by the single primary theme it expresses about getting healthcare: an access barrier, a cost concern, distrust of a provider, or a complaint about wait times. Pick the theme the comment is mostly about.

prompt_versions.prompt_text: Label the following text according to this task: Classify each patient comment by the single primary theme it expresses about getting healthcare: an access barrier, a cost concern, distrust of a provider, or a complaint about wait times. Pick the theme the comment is mostly about.

edge_0001.text: I really want to see a specialist, but the co-pay is so high that I'm terrified of what the bill will look like, even though I know I need the care.
edge_0001.difficulty_reason: The patient is expressing a desire for care (access) but the primary blocker is financial (cost). It tests whether 'access' refers to physical/logistical availability or the ability to obtain care in general.
edge_0001.which_aspect: Primary theme identification when two themes are inextricably linked.

edge_0002.text: I've been waiting in this lobby for three hours and the receptionist hasn't even acknowledged my presence; I'm starting to feel like they don't even care if I'm here.
edge_0002.difficulty_reason: The physical situation is a wait time issue, but the emotional sentiment is a lack of trust/respect from the staff. The annotator must decide if the 'primary' theme is the duration of the wait or the feeling of being ignored.
edge_0002.which_aspect: Sentiment vs. Situation (Subjective vs. Objective primary theme).

edge_0003.text: The clinic is technically open, but they keep telling me they are 'fully booked' for the next three weeks, and I just can't take that kind of time off work.
edge_0003.difficulty_reason: This combines a long lead time (wait time) with a logistical work constraint (access barrier). It tests the boundary of whether 'wait times' includes the time spent waiting for an initial appointment slot.

edge_0004.text: I don't trust this doctor's credentials at all, and honestly, I'm pretty sure they are just trying to overcharge me for tests I don't need.
edge_0004.difficulty_reason: The patient expresses a lack of trust in the person, but the specific reason for that lack of trust is a suspicion of high costs. It tests whether the 'root cause' (trust) or the 'manifested concern' (cost) is the primary theme.

edge_0005.text: I'm trying to find a clinic that takes my insurance, but every single one I call says they are at capacity and I'll have to wait until next month.
edge_0005.difficulty_reason: This is a 'cascading' barrier. The insurance requirement is an access barrier, but the reason they can't get in is the wait time. It tests the annotator's ability to prioritize the 'most' primary theme in a sequence of barriers.
edge_0005.which_aspect: Hierarchy of barriers in a multi-step problem.
edge_0005.labeler_notes: when it uses the word wait as the main issue at hand it is usually wait times

tested_aspects: Sentiment vs. Situation (Subjective vs. Objective primary theme).
Hierarchy of barriers in a multi-step problem.
Primary theme identification when two themes are inextricably linked.
